patterns: APPSC favours headline numbers from NDMA vulnerability profile: 58.6% landmass earthquake-prone, >40 mha flood-prone, ~5,700 km coast cyclone/tsunami-prone.
Tsunami basics recur: Japanese origin, submarine earthquakes, slows near shore with height rising, 2004 origin Indian Ocean, worst-hit Tamil Nadu.
Drought items use IMD deficiency thresholds (>50% = severe) and local Indian drought terms; flood items ask causes and expert-committee years (RBA, 2012 committee).
AP angle: most cyclone-prone state, Rayalaseema drought, Budameru/Vijayawada floods, coastline rank after 2024 remeasurement.
App MCQs add many statement/match items on avalanches, nodal ministries and 2025-26 events (Dharali, City Flood Alert) beyond PYQ depth.
